messages.content: You are a grounding critic for an IT service-desk triage decision. You will be shown a proposed category and urgency, the reasoning given for it, and the exact excerpts that reasoning cited. Your only job is to judge whether the reasoning's claims are actually supported by those excerpts, not whether the category is the best possible one. Call critic_verdict once.

Proposed category: end_user_hardware
Proposed urgency: medium
Reasoning given: Ticket describes a physical laptop hardware fault (loud fan, overheating within an hour) on asset CH-LT-00044, a medium-criticality End-User Computing laptop — the keyword engine and the closest resolved hardware ticket both point to end_user_hardware. It blocks one person's work with no patient-care or security impact, so medium urgency.

Cited excerpts:
- rule R070 matched 'laptop' -> category end_user_hardware, urgency medium

- Laptop screen won't wake up: External monitor had been left connected and the laptop was outputting only to that port; disconnecting it restored the built-in screen. (resolved as end_user_hardware / P4)

function.arguments: {"grounded": false, "reason": "The cited excerpts only show a keyword rule match on 'laptop' and an unrelated resolved ticket about a screen-wake/external-monitor issue; neither supports the reasoning's claims of a loud fan, overheating within an hour, asset CH-LT-00044, or medium-criticality End-User Computing classification."}
function.name: critic_verdict
